batch_prep.station: Sunday -- The Big Bake + Bases (about 45 min active, several hours hands-off)
tasks: Start the Rosemary Focaccia dough first thing -- it needs 4-5 hours of mostly hands-off proofing, so get it going before anything else. Bake it toward the end of your prep block.
Blend and freeze 4 servings of the Strawberry Mango Smoothie Bowl base (frozen berries + Greek yogurt + protein powder). This covers breakfast Sunday through Wednesday.
Cook 1.5 cups dry quinoa (3 cups cooked) for the Mediterranean lunch bowls.

Cook the Mediterranean Quinoa Chicken Chickpea Tahini Bowl lunches for Sun-Wed (4 days): grill or pan-sear the full batch of chicken thighs now (don't smoke it yet -- reserve a portion of raw/cooked thighs for Wednesday's smoker dinner if you'd rather smoke everything fresh Wednesday instead).
Hard-boil 4 eggs for Austin's lunch bowls.
Make the tahini dressing and store separately from the bowls.

batch_prep.station: Sunday -- Ramen (Soup of the Week, 50 min)
tasks: This is the new weekly Soup of the Week feature -- plan on rotating in a new soup most weeks going forward.
Caramelize the spring onions, build the broth, and cook the noodles fresh right before serving (noodles get soggy if they sit in the broth).
Sear the shrimp toppers and soft-boil the eggs just before serving.
If there's extra soup, store the broth/veg separately from any leftover noodles -- 2 days refrigerated, or freeze the broth up to 2 months.

batch_prep.station: Sunday or midweek -- Basil & White Bean Pasta Salad + Chicken Skewers (for Thu-Sat lunches)
tasks: Marinate the chicken for the skewers Sunday (or up to 8 hours ahead), then grill closer to Thursday if you'd rather have it fresher -- the pasta salad itself holds well up to 48 hours.
Cook the pasta, mix with cannellini beans, pesto, spinach, and cheeses. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before the first lunch.

batch_prep.station: Wednesday or midweek -- Egg Bake (for Thu-Sat breakfasts)
tasks: Bake the Banana Pepper Cheddar Cottage Cheese Egg Bake Wednesday night so it's ready to grab Thursday morning.

This week uses both salmon fillets (Monday), about half the tilapia (Tuesday), the full 16 oz three-pepper blend (Wednesday), the ramen noodles from the basement (Sunday), the quinoa, garbanzo beans, tahini, pearl couscous, and cannellini beans on hand.
Remaining tilapia (about 1 lb) stays in the freezer for a future week.
Shrimp is split across Sunday's ramen toppers and Thursday's Thai basil shrimp -- buy a little extra (about 8 oz) as a buffer since the exact split is approximate.
Steered clear of Mexican cuisine and corn tortillas this week per your request -- the tortillas are still in the pantry for next time.

new_this_week.focaccia_added: Rosemary Focaccia added to the recipe library as a standalone bread/component recipe (from Restaurant Dropout Week 130). Bake Sunday, use through the week.
new_this_week.soup_of_the_week: Caramelized Spring Onion Ramen is the debut entry in a new recurring Soup of the Week feature for fall/winter 2026. Plan on featuring a rotating soup dinner most weeks -- swap in a new one each week once this rotation is running.
new_this_week.cameron_macro_adjustments: Cameron's smoothie bowl, Moroccan tilapia, and lamb keftedes portions were scaled down this week from their stored recipe-library defaults (which were sized closer to a 1500 cal/day target) to match her actual 1100-1200 cal/day Household Health target. Worth updating those three library entries with a proper 'Cameron -- lighter portion' variant so future weeks don't have to re-derive this.
